title: New Sports Channels & Upgraded TV Experience
message: Live TV is better than ever! We've added premier sports channels—including Sky Sports News, Main Event, Premier League, and Football—delivering smooth, stutter-free streams so you never miss trending football action. Explore our sleek new layout with organized categories (Local, Entertainment, Sports), Watch History for quick channel switching, and a live TV EPG to track your favorite broadcasts.
